name: 10006 · New York, NY
findings: ZIP 10006 (New York) has 160 nonprofit organizations. 80 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 74 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 10006 (New York) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 10006 (New York) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 9.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 74 organizations here; 24% of all organizations here have no identified type.
